name: Waterman's Beach Lobster
closed_reason: Closed for good Sept. 4, 2016 after 30 seasons (James Beard America's Classics 2001); the family did not sell the name, and the building now houses Waterman's Beach Brewery.

name: McLaughlin's Lobster Shack
closed_reason: Closed Aug. 23, 2026 after 48 years at Lincolnville Beach; owner cited health and long hours, building to be auctioned Oct. 2, 2026.

name: The Lobster Pound Restaurant
closed_reason: Last served lobster in 2023; storm-damaged in January 2024; its website says the restaurant is permanently closed and the building reopened in 2025 as a gift shop.

name: Whale's Tooth Pub
closed_reason: Closed about two years before August 2026; sold in spring 2026 but not reopened as of Aug. 26, 2026.

name: Must Be Nice Lobster
closed_reason: Owner Sadie Samuels announced its closing in June 2026 to focus on lobstering; the Dockside Family Restaurant is returning to the space.

name: Home Kitchen Cafe
closed_reason: Owners announced it closes for good Oct. 18, 2026 after 18 years (retirement, staffing).

name: Jodie's Cafe and Bakery
closed_reason: Permanently closed; owner announced it July 5, 2026 after a closure that began in May.

name: Sarah's Cafe
closed_reason: Gone: Jodie's Cafe moved into 'the former Sarah's Cafe' space in 2022; its old domain now serves unrelated spam.

name: Ancho Honey
closed_reason: Owner Malcolm Bedell said in April 2025 the Tenants Harbor takeout would not reopen (costs, staffing).

name: Dip Net (Port Clyde General Store)
closed_reason: Store and Dip Net restaurant destroyed by fire Sept. 27, 2023; the owner's site still says 'temporarily closed' with a pledge to rebuild, and no reopening was found.
